name: Start Your Natural Aquarium
promise: For freshwater hobbyists who want a soil-based planted tank that runs itself. Get a custom substrate, plant, and stocking plan built for your specific setup — from a practitioner running the method on live tanks.

name: Know If Your Living Water System Is Buildable Before You Break Ground
promise: For serious ecosystem builders ready to scale beyond the tank. Find out whether your living water system is buildable — biology, compliance, and site conditions scoped before you commit construction money.

name: Corporate Aquarium Design & Installation
promise: For facilities managers, designers, and hospitality directors who want a living installation that holds its quality long-term — not a maintenance liability. Specified for your site before any money moves.
